meta.title: The Seat in the Front
meta.logline: Growing up in the back seat watching older siblings drive, the youngest family member nervously learns the steering wheel and becomes the reliable driver everyone calls, day or night.
meta.audience: Family, friends, and short-film reviewers watching on vertical mobile screens.
meta.intent: Evoke quiet nostalgia, personal growth, and warm familial pride.
